spec.assertion: it.skip (no aggro/taunt primitive; scope-lock boss deals no damage). Active guard asserts no `stun`/`targetStatus` effect exists anywhere in the override — fails under the nearest-wrong 'taunt ≈ stun the boss' encoding — plus a no-silent-drop check that the line is recorded in unmodeled/note.

Structural: lastBullet trigger + self target + defPct 23.82 + durationSec 5. Behavioural: buffApply count on the shipped model is ≥5 and strictly exceeds the passive counterfactual (≤2) — fails under a 'start of battle' misread; and the shotFired counterfactual fires 3–10× as often (6-round magazine) — fails if the trigger were per-shot.
Every defPct buffApply has durationShots undefined (seconds, never a round count) and a finite expiresFrame (never permanent) — fails under the 'for N rounds' and 'permanent self buff' misreads.

Removing the defPct effect leaves every slug's total byte-identical; re-stating the SAME buff as atkPct 23.82 strictly raises anchor's total (non-vacuity: the buff really lands) and still leaves teammates identical (self-scope). Fails under a defence-as-ATK fudge.

it.skip (no enemy-projectile entity). Active guards: no effect anywhere carries value/atkPct 25.6; skill2 declares no projectileExplosionPct/attackDamagePct/atkPct; stripping skill2 changes no unit's total — while a 25.6 attackDamagePct probe injected on anchor DOES raise her total, so the inertness claim is non-vacuous. Fails under the RL-flavoured 'projectileExplosionPct 25.6' nearest-wrong.

Structural: exactly one flatDamage, atkPct 304.45, trigger burstCast, target enemy, core not true ('all enemies' is not a multiplier on a single boss; no core-strike wording). Behavioural: half/base/double atkPct runs keep impact count (and thus gauge/rotation) fixed, so (double−base) = 2×(base−half) exactly, and (base−half) > 0 pins non-vacuity.

Trigger is burstCast, not fullBurstEnter; re-keying to fullBurstEnter strictly raises anchor's total (over-fires on team FBs she did not cast + takes the +50% FB major). Teammates are unmoved by any burst-magnitude patch, pinning the hit as self-contained.

hasPierce not true (RL, no pierce wording); no `ignored`/`unsupported` effect kinds; the entire override reduces to buff + a single flatDamage — any additional effect kind is an invention not derivable from this kit.

fixtures: controlComp('anchor', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / anchor / helm (B3), deterministic, no seed. The fixed B3 is kept because a full-burst window must actually open for the burst-vs-fullBurstEnter discriminator to mean anything, and helm's buffs do not confound any assertion here (all claims are deltas against a same-fixture baseline, or self-scoped event counts). 10 hoisted runs: baseline + 9 counterfactuals (defPct→atkPct, defPct removed, trigger→passive, trigger→shotFired, skill2 stripped, 25.6 Damage-Up sensitivity probe, burst ×0.5, burst ×2, burst→fullBurstEnter). RISK FLAGGED: anchor is herself a Burst I and shares stage 1 with liter in this fixture, so her burst may not cast on every rotation — the burst group therefore asserts a strictly positive contribution explicitly, so a fixture that never lets her cast fails loudly and identifiably instead of passing vacuously. Burst counterfactuals SCALE the atkPct rather than deleting the effect, deliberately: a deleted flatDamage would also delete its burst-gauge impact and could shift rotation, breaking the linearity identity.
gaps: it.skip — skill1 'Taunt for 5 sec': no aggro/threat primitive in the effect schema, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage and has no target-selection model, so the line has no observable payload in v1.
it.skip — skill2 'damage dealt to that projectile ▲ 25.6%': the sim models no enemy projectiles as damageable entities, so the buff has no surface to apply to; the only faithful model is board-inert.

NOT ASSERTED (undocumented event fields): the 5-second window is pinned structurally (durationSec === 5) plus durationShots-undefined / finite-expiresFrame, not by frame arithmetic — the packet documents expiresFrame on buffApply but no apply-frame field, so an exact 300-frame window could not be asserted blind.

NOT ASSERTED (undocumented event fields): per-unit attribution on `damage`/`burstCast` events. All burst claims are made through per-slug totals deltas instead, which are fully documented (totals(res) is a per-slug map).

Override shape ambiguity: the packet describes the OverrideFile both as slot -> Block[] and slot -> { blocks: Block[] }; every read/patch goes through shape-tolerant helpers so no counterfactual can silently no-op under whichever shape is real.
